Letter of Recommendation (LOR) Reference Sheet
For: Mr. Damodar Patnekar (Bodhami)
Applicant: Anson Menino Barreto
Thank you for agreeing to support my Master's applications. Below are a few points from my
internship and final-year project that you may find useful while writing the recommendation. Please
feel free to include only the points that best reflect your experience working with me.
Internship & Professional Growth
 Adapted quickly to a professional software development environment.

 Demonstrated responsibility, accountability, and a strong work ethic.
 Took ownership of assigned tasks and contributed proactively.
 Communicated effectively with mentors and teammates.
Final Year Project – AI Resume Parsing & Candidate Shortlisting
Platform
 Served as the Team Leader for the industry-sponsored final-year project developed in
collaboration with Bodhami.
 Coordinated the team's development efforts and project milestones.

 Worked on AI-powered resume parsing, candidate information extraction, and automated
shortlisting workflows.
 Contributed to building features aligned with real enterprise requirements and practical AI
applications.
Technical Capabilities
 Strong software engineering and problem-solving skills.
 Quickly understood business requirements and translated them into technical solutions.
 Demonstrated the ability to learn new technologies and apply them effectively.
Leadership & Collaboration

Leadership & Collaboration
 Led a multidisciplinary student team throughout the project.
 Coordinated task allocation and encouraged effective teamwork.
 Demonstrated initiative while resolving technical challenges.
Professional Qualities
 Professional attitude and communication.
 Dependable, responsible, and receptive to feedback.
 Strong willingness to learn and continuously improve.
 Well-prepared for postgraduate study and a career in Artificial Intelligence.
Please include only the points you feel are appropriate based on your experience working with me.
